#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using ll = long long;
vector<ll> ones(30);

ll dfs(ll n) {
    if (n <= 6) return n;

    ll left = 1000000000LL, right = 1000000000LL;
    bool have_left = false, have_right = false;

    for (int i = 0; i < 20 && !(have_left && have_right); ++i) {
        if (!have_left && ones[i] > n) {
            left = dfs(n % ones[i - 1]) + i * (n / ones[i - 1]);
            have_left = true;
        }
        if (!have_right && ones[i] >= n) {
            if (ones[i] - n < n)
                right = dfs(ones[i] - n) + i + 1;
            have_right = true;
        }
    }

    return min(left, right);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    ones[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < 18; ++i)
        ones[i] = ones[i - 1] * 10 + 1;

    ll n;
    cin >> n;
    cout << dfs(n) << '\n';
    return 0;
}

using ll = long long;

static const ll rep[30] = {

    11111111LL, 111111111LL, 1111111111LL, 11111111111LL,
    111111111111LL, 1111111111111LL, 11111111111111LL,
    111111111111111LL, 1111111111111111LL, 11111111111111111LL,
    111111111111111111LL, 0LL, 0LL
};

int first_greater(ll n) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 20; ++i)
        if (rep[i] > n) return i;
    return 20;
}

int first_at_least(ll n) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 20; ++i)

    return 20;

    ll r1 = 1000000000LL, r2 = 1000000000LL;

    int p = first_greater(n);

    int q = first_at_least(n);
    if (q < 20 && rep[q] - n < n)

    return min(r1, r2);
}
